# Giveaways and contests

**Run legal, fair giveaways: free entry, official rules, platform rules, a verifiable draw, honest disclosure, no crypto traps.**

Runs a legal, fair giveaway or contest for a creator, brand or AI character — choosing a sweepstakes vs a skill contest, no-purchase-necessary entry, official rules, platform promotion rules (Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit), US state filing over $5,000, prize taxes, UK CAP Code, FTC disclosure, crypto and token prize cautions, and a verifiable winner draw script with an audit log. Use when someone wants to run a giveaway, contest, sweepstakes or prize draw, write official rules, pick a winner fairly, give away crypto, tokens or NFTs, or asks whether "follow, like and tag to win" is allowed.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 2 h to set up, 1 h to draw and award | — | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Choose draw or contest, never lottery
2. Size the prize and the paperwork
3. Pick a mechanic every platform allows
4. Write and publish the official rules
5. Announce with every required line
6. Export entries, remove the ineligible
7. Run a draw anyone can verify
8. Notify, award and publish the result

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/giveaways-and-contests.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/giveaways-and-contests.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/giveaways-and-contests.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/giveaways-and-contests.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill giveaways-and-contests`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `giveaways-and-contests.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/giveaways-and-contests`.
